name: Dev Container para SPA simple
postStartCommand: bash -c "HTTP_PROXY='${HTTP_PROXY:-1.1.1.1:80}}' && HTTPS_PROXY='${HTTPS_PROXY:-1.1.1.1:80}}' && echo 'Acquire::http::Proxy \"$HTTP_PROXY\";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/proxy.conf && echo 'Acquire::https::Proxy \"$HTTPS_PROXY\";' >> /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/proxy.conf && python3 -m http.server 3000"
